about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I work on developing complete web applications, from data modeling to the interface, with emphasis on organization, automated testing, and documentation from the start.
about.paragraph2: During my studies in Systems Analysis and Development, I deepened my interest in architecture and service integration, directing my focus toward systems that grow with consistency.
about.paragraph3: My goal is to build software that remains clear and sustainable over time, avoiding short-term improvised solutions.
